symptoms: Pale green or yellowish patches on the upper leaf surface
Olive-green to grey velvety fungal growth on the underside, mainly along veins
Leaves curl, wither and drop from the bottom upward
Most common in polyhouses and dense, humid canopies

severity_cues.early: Few yellow patches, velvety growth only under a few leaves
severity_cues.advanced: Widespread yellowing and defoliation, velvety layer under most leaves

favorable_conditions: High humidity above 85 percent, poor airflow, temperatures 20 to 25 C, crowded planting

treatment.summary: Drop the humidity and protect with scheduled fungicide, airflow is half the cure
steps: Ventilate: in protected cultivation, open sides and run fans to bring humidity below 80 percent
Remove and destroy infected lower leaves
Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP at 2.0 g per litre, repeat every 7 days
Space plants and prune for airflow

products.name: Chlorothalonil 75 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

products.name: Mancozeb 75 WG
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 g per litre
Resistant varieties for the next cycle, wider spacing, morning-only irrigation

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not harvest within 7 days of any fungicide spray
